blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) pushed back against claims that it failed to execute power reserve deals on time, leading to red and yellow alerts in the Visayas. The country’s grid operator committed to working closely with the Department of Energy (DOE) to boost grid reliability, acknowledging the agency’s concerns after a series of power alerts in the region. READ: Visayas grid under yellow alert On Wednesday, NGCP made this commitment after DOE Secretary Sharon Garin criticized the grid operator for allegedly failing to complete critical ancillary service contracts on time.
